text:
alex: quick async standup — night ops check-in
alex: what I did: drained 4 nodes in eu-west to test spot fallback, verified canary routing to dedicated pool worked
alex: blocker: noticed a ~10% higher cpu steal on g4dn nodes after the drain, not sure if autoscaler is overreacting

maria: saw that too — I opened ticket INF-412 to track, looks correlated to kube-proxy churn after cordon
maria: what I did: pushed a tiny autoscaler cooldown tweak to staging, will promote if numbers look stable in 30m
maria: today: monitor eu-west for 1h and roll tweak to prod if no regressions :eyes:

jin: FYI I patched the capacity-mapper script to prefer reserved pools when region headroom < 15%
jin: command I ran: `python tools/capacity-mapper.py --region eu-west --prefer-reserved`
jin: results: reserved usage bumped by 6% and spot spill decreased, will add metric to dashboard tomorrow

samir: quick ask — can we reserve an extra 2 nodes in ap-southeast for tomorrow's demo? estimate peak ~120 qps/sample
samir: if yes I can open quota request with cloud, else I'll prep fallback routing to us-west

alex: @samir go ahead with the request, add me + maria to approval so we can expedite if quota needs billing sign-off

maria: pinged infra-approvals, left note about demo time window and auto-return policy

jin: small note — deploy-bot reported a canary spike at 1743219900, grabbed logs:
```
deploy-bot: Canary rollout report: model-serving-canary v2 -> error-rate 0.9% (threshold 0.5%)
stack: grpc timeout on node eu-west-3-14, retry ladder triggered
```

alex: I dug into that — root cause was transient network blip between az3 and storage. I added an extra retry in the serving client for the canary path
alex: will watch error-rate channel, but we should be fine; added a regression alert on the canary dashboard

samir: thanks. If the ap-southeast quota comes back slow, i'll temporarily route 25% traffic to dedicated pool in us-west (low latency impact for demo)

maria: +1. Also adding a shortrun smoke test for sample flows at 30m intervals for the demo window

alex: final notes: if anyone sees sustained spot evictions / node flapping, please report in #incidents and tag me. otherwise we'll reconvene in the morning to reconcile metrics

deploy-bot: ✅ Backup snapshot created for eu-west reserved pool at 1743220400

jin: thanks team — leaving monitoring on, will post a short recap in 45m with numbers
